_comment: Accepted divergences from the Stitch designs. Each entry is a reviewed decision; anything not listed here fails verify:design-coverage.

allow.heading: 2024 Budget Tracker
allow.reason: Design sample-data workbook title. The workbooks grid is implemented and renders the user's REAL workbooks (title, sheets, updated, size) from GET /spreadsheets; a design fixture title can never appear for an arbitrary account.

allow.heading: SaaS Financial Model
allow.reason: Design sample-data system-template name. The template gallery grid is implemented and renders the seeded system templates + the user's own (name, description, category, preview, instantiate) from GET /spreadsheet-templates; the gallery shows whatever templates exist, never the design's fixture names.
